database.query: SELECT CONVERT(char(10), GETDATE(), 103) AS data_referencia, TOTALDIA.totaldia, CANCELADA_DIA.cancelada_dia FROM (SELECT SUM(OV.VALORLIQUIDO) AS totaldia FROM CM_ORDENSVENDA OV INNER JOIN CM_OPERACOESFATURAMENTO OFAT ON OFAT.HANDLE = OV.OPERACAOFATURAMENTO WHERE OV.DATAINCLUSAO >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND OV.DATAINCLUSAO < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AND OV.STATUS <> 5 AND OV.USUARIOINCLUIU <> 24 AND OV.OPERACAOFATURAMENTO NOT IN (58, 63, 113, 145) AND OV.PESSOA <> 16866 AND OFAT.K_TIPONATUREZAOPER IN (1, 5)) AS TOTALDIA CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM((B.QUANTIDADE - B.QUANTIDADEFATURADA) * (B.VALORLIQUIDO / NULLIF(B.QUANTIDADE, 0))) AS cancelada_dia FROM CM_ORDENSVENDA OVC INNER JOIN CM_OPERACOESFATURAMENTO OFAT ON OFAT.HANDLE = OVC.OPERACAOFATURAMENTO INNER JOIN CM_ORDEMVENDAITENS B ON B.ORDEMVENDA = OVC.HANDLE AND B.STATUS IN (7, 6) WHERE OVC.DATASTATUS >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND OVC.DATASTATUS < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AND OVC.USUARIOINCLUIU <> 24 AND OFAT.K_TIPONATUREZAOPER = 1) AS CANCELADA_DIA
